text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Completely out of breath after finishing 
the race, Tosen Jordan tasted firsthand 
just what kind of hellhole the Senior-year 
GⅠ races truly were.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship, however, is still bursting with 
energy even after the race! She's already 
hyping up the crowd! Urrrgh, she's 
seriously so annoying!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Burning with competitive rivalry toward 
Gold Ship, Tosen Jordan's heart held no 
more doubts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Whether she sensed it or not, Gold Ship 
offered to continue their contest, 
challenging her to race next in the Tenno 
Sho (Spring).
